tierNote: Tiers are playstyle- and composition-dependent, not absolute rankings. WSG rewards survivability (stamina) and coordination, so placements shift with team comp and player skill.

classes.summary: Strong damage: Wing Clip, Concussive Shot, and Track Humanoids.
Strong support: enemy/friendly Dispel and Blackout.
Strong CC: Polymorph, Frostbolt, Frost Nova, and Frostbite.
Strong CC and damage: Sap, Gouge, and Kick.
Strong CC and blanket damage: Fear and Curse of Recklessness.
Strong CC and survivability: Root, Bash, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, and Bear Form.
Good survivability and support (Blessings, Hammer of Justice, Divine Protection, Holy Light) but countered by Dispel/Purge.
Good survivability and CC (Hamstring, Charge, Disarm, Shield Bash/Block) but heavily locked down.
Good CC and support (Purge, Earthbind/Tremor Totem, Earth Shock, Healing Wave) but lacks damage.
